scope: P5 and P6 only; master Goal continues
p6_reuse: Reuse the three P5 A5 runs only if the source/config policy remains identical; no model rerun solely to rename the stage.
matched_contract: Same model, tools, task, seed text, update boundaries, response schema, authority, retry policy and rubric. Different empty namespaces and IDs. A4 has no bounded policy; A5 uses only declared rank/count mechanics.
p5_gate: Each arm passes all three preregistered task/mechanism controls. A5 still acquires exact current primary for changed/retained. Irrelevant must actually expose secondary below current primary in the initial Provider request; A5 lowers exact gets versus A4, adds no search and preserves the action.
arguments: Actual completed call count and approved public index must match rubric. JSON numbers and booleans retain type. Strings allow outer trim and casefold only. No outcome-specific synonyms or substantive normalization.
lineage: Compare all eligible earlier ordinary replies against their actual generating snapshots and declared, verified public-update boundaries. Report precision/recall counts; 0/0 is undefined, not perfect. Check actual Provider markers, response IDs and hashes; preserve checkpoint originals and executed tool-call JSON.
factual: Check item order and actual current/unknown raw values, withheld stale/deleted bodies, exact current version acquisition, and actual newly billed Store.gets. A higher rank CURRENT item is a mechanical candidate, not proof of semantic sufficiency.
missing_conflict: Zero completed business calls alone is insufficient; Root reads terminal answer for honest missing/conflict report or clarification, and records intermediate unsupported tool claims independently.
no_stale: Require correct action, no exact get, no derived demotion and no extra search.
mixed: All four statuses must actually occur together after updates; missing exposure is a mechanism failure even if action looks correct.
failure: Preserve every run and cost. Report first broken link and at least two hypotheses; no changing rubric, replacing cases or sweeping settings after results. A generic implementation repair gets a new source freeze and minimal counterexample run.
cost: Continuous artifacts/ser-v20/budget.json; before P5: 41 generations, 36834 generation tokens, 589 embedding tokens. Report generations, input/output tokens, embedding, exact gets, inclusive projection CPU/wall, storage and unsupported/unknown/truncated results separately.
